Ltd., China (TMARL), a step-down subsidiary of the Company, has inaugurated and commenced commercial operations of its new Tap Hole Clay Manufacturing Plant on 16.11.26.The state ofthe-art facility, established with technical support from Material Subsidiary of the Company, Sheffield Refractories Limited, U.K. is designed for manufacture of pitch-free and tar-free tap hole clay for blast furnace applications and is strategically positioned to serve customers across the Far East, South-East Asia and Oceania regions. The project has been implemented as part of the Group''s business expansion and growth initiatives with an investment of approximately GBP 172,000 (equivalent to about Rs. 2.15 Cr), financed through internal accruals. The plant has an installed production capacity of 2,000 MT per annum on a single-shift basis and is expected to generate annual revenue of approximately GBP 2 million (equivalent to about Rs. 25 Cr) at full utilization.
